title: sortBySelector not working anymore when set customRanking
body:
Hi,
I have setSetting my index to update customRanking field.

I have updated from

```
customRanking: [
            "desc(best_offer.last_modified)"
        ],
```

To

```
customRanking: [
             "desc(stock)",
             "desc(created_on)",
             "desc(last_modified)"
        ],
```

I have this parameters enable :

```
forwardToReplicas: true
```

My initial index work great with this parameters but when i change the index with sortBySelector widget, it don't sort anymore  !

I reverse to the original customRanking config but now it don't sort too...

Could you help me please ?

**Environment:**

* I use the CDN version of algoliasearch : https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/algoliasearch/3/algoliasearch.min.js
* Version instantsearch.min.js 2.10.3

Thanks
